title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hook + quality gating metrics integration
author: Priya Raman
description: Motivation: Prevent prompt-set regressions from reaching main by running per-prompt checks as part of CI and gating merges on quality metrics. This PR adds a new GitHub Actions workflow (eval-gating.yml) that runs the eval-harness per-prompt runner, exports fine-grained metrics, and fails the job when any prompt falls below configured thresholds; it also wires the metrics exporter to our observability pipeline so teams can inspect per-prompt signal over time. Changes: 1) .github/workflows/eval-gating.yml - new workflow that triggers on PRs to main and on a schedule for baseline checks; 2) eval-harness/ci/ci_gate_runner.py - a lightweight runner to execute prompt sets, compute per-prompt pass/fail, and emit summary JSON expected by the action; 3) eval-harness/config/prompt_sets/default.yaml - added metadata fields for per-prompt thresholds and severity; 4) eval-harness/tests/test_per_prompt_gate.py - unit tests and a small integration harness with mocked model outputs; 5) observability/metrics/metrics_exporter.py - added per-prompt metric labels and export path; 6) docs/guides/per-prompt-gating.md - developer guide for threshold configuration and triage; 7) Makefile - convenience targets for local gating runs. Checklist: - [x] Add CI workflow to run per-prompt checks - [x] Implement runner and exporter - [x] Add unit tests and integration smoke tests - [x] Documentation for on-call and developers - [x] Add Linear link and update release notes Usage: The workflow runs on push to feature branches and opens a check run; the runner produces a summary JSON and sets the job as failed if any prompt with severity=high is below its threshold or if a configurable fraction of prompts fail. Teams can opt prompts out or mark them as advisory. Rollback/mitigation: The gating workflow can be disabled via repo-level settings and the runner returns non-zero only when configured thresholds are breached; emergency rollbacks are documented in docs/guides/per-prompt-gating.md. Backward compatibility: The changes are additive; existing prompt sets without threshold metadata default to legacy global thresholds. Implementation notes: thresholds are evaluated using absolute metric values and a moving-baseline fallback; metrics exported include prompt_id, metric_name, value, threshold, severity, run_id. CI retry: workflow supports a single automatic re-run on flaky network/model timeouts. Related: ENG-4256 (per-prompt gating), QA-210 (test coverage), SUP-987 (customer incident inspired requirement).

merge: Merged via squash on 2025-01-22 by Evan Cho (squash and merge). Commit message: 'eval-harness: per-prompt CI gating + metrics integration (ENG-4256)'.
release_notes: Added per-prompt regression CI hook and quality gating integration: new GitHub Actions workflow 'eval-gating.yml', a CI runner for per-prompt checks, per-prompt metrics exported to observability, and docs guiding threshold configuration and triage. This prevents critical prompt regressions from merging and provides teams with time-series visibility.
notes_for_oncall: If the gating workflow is failing at scale: 1) Check run_id and artifacts uploaded by the action; 2) Verify model endpoints are reachable and not rate limited; 3) If failures are noisy, consider flipping severity for non-blocking prompts or disable the workflow temporarily via repo settings; 4) Contact infra-oncall and @Priya Raman for rollbacks.
examples: Example local run: make eval-gate-local && python eval-harness/ci/ci_gate_runner.py --prompt-set eval-harness/config/prompt_sets/default.yaml --output summary.json ; the CI action expects summary.json with fields: run_id, prompt_results (list), overall_status.
